summary: Label for the release stage of a site or feature (Alpha, Beta, Preview, Demo, New, Experimental, Deprecated, Coming soon): an inline chip or a full-width banner with description, action, and dismiss.
whenToUse: Indicating that a section or feature is in alpha, beta, preview, or experimental.
Warning at the top of the site that it is a demo environment (“Demo environment: data is reset every night”).
Highlighting a menu item or a newly released feature (“New”).
whenNotToUse: Generic item statuses (Paid, Draft, Active): use Badge.
Counts or dots on icons and avatars: use IndicatorBadge.
Labels overlaid on the corner of cards or images: use Ribbon.
System messages that require action or have a severity (errors, maintenance): use Banner or Alert.

props.name: stage
props.description: Release stage: determines the localized default text and style.

props.name: description
props.description: Banner only: explanatory text next to the label.

props.name: action
props.description: Banner only: action slot, e.g. the “Send feedback” link.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Banner only: shows a dismiss IconButton with the localized label “Dismiss”.

keyboard.action: In the banner, moves focus to the action and the dismiss button; the chip is not focusable.

accessibility: The stage text is always real, localized text: color is only supporting.
The banner has role="note" and is named by the stage label (aria-labelledby); you can override role and aria-label via props.
The dismiss button is an IconButton with the accessible name “Dismiss”; after dismissing, move focus to a sensible element.
The description is not shown in a Tooltip on the chip: the chip is not focusable, so a tooltip would be unreachable by keyboard and touch.
In forced-colors mode, chips and banners use system borders instead of backgrounds and gradients.
responsive: The banner wraps: label and description take the first line, while actions and dismiss move below in narrow containers.
The chip stays on one line, with an ellipsis if space runs out.
customization: Tokens: --dc-gradient-accent (beta), --dc-color-accent-default (new, experimental), --dc-color-data-6 (demo, cyan), warning/info feedback colors (alpha, preview), --dc-color-surface-muted and --dc-color-text-muted (deprecated).
commonMistakes: Using StageLabel for content statuses (Draft, Published): that is PublishStatus or Badge.
Stacking multiple stage banners on top of each other: pick the most important message.
Making the banner non-dismissible on every page when the message is not critical.
